zh.principle: **协议**：SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换（SPAKE2+, an Augmented Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) Protocol）。RFC 9383 摘要给出机制定义：「This document describes SPAKE2+, a Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) protocol run between two parties for deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password.」并说明它是增强型：「SPAKE2+ is an augmented PAKE protocol, as only one party has knowledge of the password.」
zh.why: 动机是口令不能裸奔于交换过程：摘要把目标写成「deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password」，并把工程卖点列在一起——「This method is simple to implement, compatible with any prime-order group, and computationally efficient.」
zh.used: 使用位置写在 §1：增补性质在执行受限、攻击者无法提前查询口令散列盐值的场景特别有价值，文件举出两类约束——「a constraint may be when physical proximity through a local network is required or when a first authentication factor is required for initiation of the protocol.」摘要给出通用形态：只有一侧持有口令，仍完成认证并得到会话密钥。
zh.broken: 限度一是身份模型：「SPAKE2+ is the asymmetric or augmented version of SPAKE2, wherein only one party has knowledge of the password.」服务器侧仍需保存盐值/记录。限度二是标准地位：文件自陈「Neither SPAKE2 nor SPAKE2+ was selected as the result of the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) PAKE selection competition.」，页眉 Category 为 Informational，不是 Standards Track。
zh.history:
版本信息在页眉：流别为 Independent Submission，Category 标注 Informational，日期 September 2023，作者 T.Taubert（Apple Inc.）与 C.A.Wood。§1 交代血缘：本文内容从「[RFC9382], which specifies SPAKE2」拆出，因对称与增补 PAKE 的用例不同而分别规范。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。 预期输出：按 SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

en.principle: **Protocol**: SPAKE2+, an Augmented Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) Protocol (SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换). The abstract defines the mechanism: "This document describes SPAKE2+, a Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) protocol run between two parties for deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password." and states the variant: "SPAKE2+ is an augmented PAKE protocol, as only one party has knowledge of the password."
en.why: The motivation is that a password must not be exposed by the exchange: the abstract states the goal as "deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password" and bundles the engineering claims with it — "This method is simple to implement, compatible with any prime-order group, and computationally efficient."
en.used:
The placement is in §1: the augmented property is valuable where execution is constrained and the adversary cannot query the salt of the password-hashing function ahead of the attack, and the document names two constraints — "a constraint may be when physical proximity through a local network is required or when a first authentication factor is required for initiation of the protocol." The abstract gives the general shape: only one party holds the password, yet authentication and a session key result.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: The first limit is the identity model: "SPAKE2+ is the asymmetric or augmented version of SPAKE2, wherein only one party has knowledge of the password." — the other side still stores the salt or record. The second is standing: the document states "Neither SPAKE2 nor SPAKE2+ was selected as the result of the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) PAKE selection competition." and its masthead Category is Informational, not Standards Track.
en.history: The masthead gives the history: the Independent Submission stream with Category: Informational, dated September 2023 and authored by T. Taubert (Apple Inc.) and C. A. Wood. Clause 1 records the lineage — the content was split out from "[RFC9382], which specifies SPAKE2", because symmetric and augmented PAKEs serve different use cases and so warrant different specifications.

zh: augmented PAKE：仅一方知道口令的 PAKE 变体。
strong shared key：由协议导出的会话密钥。
prime-order group：协议可适配的群类型。
Independent Submission：RFC Editor 独立投稿流。
password file：验证方保存的口令派生记录。
en: Augmented PAKE: the variant where only one party knows the password.
Strong shared key: the session key the protocol derives.
Prime-order group: the group class the protocol fits.
Independent Submission: the RFC Editor stream it appeared in.
Password file: the verifier’s stored password-derived record.
